scope: Only maximal-pressure 50-48 halftime states: four fixed synthetic roster histories, both orientations, 32 fresh seeds per state.
primary: Drop-counter minus Hold, originally trailing side win probability. One primary comparison; fixed 95% Hoeffding bound sqrt(2*log(2/0.05)/256).
secondary: Pressure-only, transition-only and interaction contrasts, margins, time and event rates are descriptive. No automatic action selection, threshold change, sample expansion, seed replacement, pooling with old pilots or official adoption.
replay: First two trials per oriented state/arm: 64 matched future replays. Every scientific ledger independently audited.
recoveryGate: New adapter must reproduce every saved compact metric for all 1248 historical single-slider outcomes and preserve native gameplay code outside declared restore/intervention wiring. Historical full ledgers/adapter source are unavailable; do not claim byte-exact historical-event reproduction.
preflight: Two opposite-orientation checkpoints with separate seeds, 8 outcomes excluded from new sample.
